name: 2-phenoxyethanamine
summary: Phenoxyethylamine, also known as 2-phenoxyethylamine, is a chemical compound related to phenethylamine (2-phenylethylamine). It is a parent compound of several psychedelic-related drugs including 3,4,5-trimethoxyphenoxyethylamine, CT-4719 (2,4-dichloro-5-methoxyphenoxyethylamine), CT-5126, and ORG-37684.
